documents.text:
Clause 4.4 (Fee Adjustments). The returned copy reads: "term by up to 3% over the fees for". We accept this change.
Clause 5 (Service Levels). The returned copy reads: ", up to a minimum of 10% of the". We do not accept this change as written. What we can agree to instead: We can raise the service credit cap to 15% of the monthly fee. Service credits need a maximum.
Clause 6 (Customer Data). The returned copy reads: "the Service. For ninety (90) days after termination". We do not accept this change as written. What we can agree to instead: We can keep Customer Data available for export for ninety days after termination.

request.answer: We accept this change. We can raise the service credit cap to 15% of the monthly fee. We can keep Customer Data available for export for ninety days after termination.
claims: We can raise the service credit cap to 15% of the monthly fee.
We can keep Customer Data available for export for ninety days after termination.
request.instructions: The source is the brief the reply was written from. A claim is supported only if the brief states the same decision about the same clause: accepted, countered with that exact position, or under review. A claim that promises something the brief does not state, or names a different term, is contradicted or not stated.
